sentences.en: With regards to high school pedagogics, to examine theoretically the practices of specific teaching method as such is a renewal of theory.

sentences.en: The basic issues of the subjects of pedagogics principle are the integration of the issues of curriculum, teaching and learning.

sentences.en: Supported by common pedagogics in teachers' college,(http://sentencedict.com/pedagogics.html) it developed teaching practice through researching study in class and term case study .

sentences.en: Therefore, we need to improve pedagogics and increase mutual Communication so as to raise students' ability in oral English.

sentences.en: This article is based on aesthetics, pedagogics and psychology and the writer's many years' experience. It mainly talks about the Chinese teaching with aesthetic arts in middle schools.

sentences.en: The theory of Philosophy, Pedagogics, Psychology , and practice of the project method become base of the emergent curriculum.

sentences.en: Pedagogics principle belongs to basic research discipline, which is also the basis of all educational branch disciplines.

sentences.en: Educational economics should become an interdisciplinarity of pedagogics and economics,[sentencedict.com] but not a subdiscipline of them.
